reviews.review:
As it stands, I would not recommend this game to anyone expecting a polished experience, but it has potential to grow into something amazing over time. Steam needs a middle ground between "yes" and "no" for review purposes.

The developer still has a long road ahead and you might want to wait out until they are a little further in the process. Do keep your eye on it, and buy it if you want to support the developer.

Yes, the basic simulation is there; you can set up transport lines between various companies and these will slowly but surely net you a decent profit allowing you to branch out from trains to other transport vehicles.

Unfortunately there are also some problems which inhibit your playing.
- The floating boxes explaining what each industrial building offloads or onloads are very large and get in the way when you're panning around trying to lay tracks.
- You have to select either a horizontal or diagonal track and there's no quick switching.
- You cannot set up a diagonal track easily. It will always need to extend three or more spaces at once so forget using it for a quick corner. I have had to delete the excess quite a few times now but this sometimes also takes away the corner you need.
- As far as I've been able to tell there are no signals for tracks yet. Perhaps I missed this or it might come with a later update, so just run a single train per track.
- You can't get to the graphics or sound menu from within the game unless you exit to the menu first.
- The menu is larger than life and elements could be shrunk down a lot while still remaining readable.
- I have had a hang at least twice now (playing the native Linux version).

This game has potential, and I hope the developer sticks with it and improves it one update at a time. Don't get disheartened by my review, it may change as the game improves.

I am keeping my eye on this title and will continue to play it when I have time, just to see the improvements happen.

Once more; buy it to support the developer and have fun with the quirks of the game as it exists now, but don't expect it to be polished.
